questions._flag: DEFECTIVE QUESTION, and CBSE says so itself. The official marking scheme (ms/p05, printed page 6 of 24) prints for Q14, in place of an answer: "No option is correct. Full marks may be awarded for attempting the question." My independent derivation agrees: cos^2(3pi/4) + cos^2(pi/3) + cos^2(theta) = 1/2 + 1/4 + cos^2(theta) = 1 gives cos(theta) = +/- 1/2, so theta = pi/3 or 2pi/3. A direction angle lies in [0, pi], which rules out the negative branch in (A) and (D); (B) is incomplete because it drops 2pi/3; (C) is simply wrong. Transcribed as printed with no answer and _noCorrectOption set. This is the SAME defective question that 65/2/1 prints as its Q6, where CBSE gave the identical no-key verdict.
